node.title: Re: cpanm, entered non existing module by accident, but installation started
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: When you use the MetaCPAN API to search for that module ([https://fastapi.metacpan.org/v1/module/DBD]) it returns the distribution [dist://HDB] because its [mod://HDB::MOD] package [https://metacpan.org/source/GMPASSOS/HDB-1.05/lib/HDB/MOD.pm#L155|contains a package DBD], so the CPAN indexer picked that up. I think it probably would have been better if the module's author had set that up so that that package didn't get indexed, but that's the way it is at the moment.
